title: xiangyazi24/palomar-qseries-row-factorization
summary: A Lean 4 verification of an explicit rank-two indefinite theta completion over Q(sqrt(5)). The registered results cover the coefficientwise row-model factorization; the exact holomorphic-sign-part bridge; summability of the defining completed-theta lattice series; a specialization of Zwegers' Lemma 2.8; the weight-one T and S transformations, including the five-to-two characteristic reduction; the exact mixed boundary derivative and Bruinier--Funke image; and a kernel-checked nonharmonicity witness.

formalizes.title: A shifted indefinite theta completion over Q(sqrt(5)): an asymmetric boundary derivative and a row-model factorization

review.reason: Lean verification of a rank-two indefinite theta completion over Q(√5).
